# Copilot Instructions

## General Guidelines
- Prefer documentation of use-cases over classes.
- Use concise, engineer-level explanations in Polish.

## Code Style
- Maintain consistent indentation and spacing.
- Follow naming conventions.

## Project-Specific Rules
- Provide lists of commands/queries.
- Include an application folder tree.
- Present one canonical CQRS example (command, handler, validator).
- Explain DTO separation clearly.
- Include an explanation of AutoMapper.
- Demonstrate dependency injection (DI) via extension methods.
